name: com.askacharge/askacharge
title: askacharge.com — EV charging network
description: Operate a network of electric vehicle charge points: live status, charging sessions, tariffs, RFID tags, customers, OCPP commands (start, stop, reboot, availability), power limits and Spanish PVPC day-ahead electricity prices. Backed by askacharge.com, an OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 CSMS. Authenticated per brand with an API key whose scopes decide which tools are visible.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key>. Created by the brand in its panel, under API keys. The key's scopes decide which tools are listed and which calls are allowed.
